['Lufthansa AirPlus Servicekarten GmbH '.company_description: Lufthansa AirPlus Servicekarten GmbH has been sold to SEB Kort Bank AB, a leading corporate payment solutions provider in the Nordics and wholly owned subsidiary of SEB Group, for around 450 million euros. The sale includes all international subsidiaries and branches of AirPlus.

['Droege Group AG '].company_description: Droege Group AG, founded by Walter P.J. Droege, operates in the areas of restructuring and turnaround advisory services. The company is based in Düsseldorf, Germany. Additionally, the Droege Group AG is associated with ALSO Holding AG, a distribution and logistics company based in Switzerland, and HAL Allergy Group, a pharmaceutical company specializing in allergy diagnostic and allergen immunotherapy products.
